title: Can Calcium Ionophore Application Enhance the ICSI Outcomes in Severe Male Factor Infertility?
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the impact of the use of calcium ionophore on the ICSI outcomes in couples with severe male factor infertility. Investigators conduct a randomized controlled trial on the sibling oocyte to justify the use of calcium ionophore in these cases.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe male factor infertility, Average response to COH,

Exclusion Criteria:

* Poor responders,
